decisions.headline: AUTOMATON报道GBA Nintendo Classics日本分级升至CERO B
decisions.summary: AUTOMATON于10月15日报道，GBA Nintendo Classics在任天堂商店显示的CERO分级已从全年龄的A级变为12岁以上的B级。报道推测这可能与新增《Metal Slug Advance》有关，但任天堂未明确说明原因，因此不将这一关联写作官方结论。
decisions.verification: 采用packet内已打开的AUTOMATON报道；可确认媒体观察到的商店分级变化，原因仅为媒体推测，不补充窗口外事件。
decisions.reason: 分级变化是具体服务信息，媒体报道与核心事实清楚；以报道时间准入，不声称变化恰好发生于该分钟。

decisions.headline: 台湾科技大学视角研究获AUTOMATON解析：通关效率不等于沉浸感
decisions.summary: AUTOMATON在10月15日介绍台湾科技大学团队此前公开的射击游戏研究。实验中，第三人称视角与较短的任务完成时间存在统计关联，但视角与沉浸感之间未发现显著差异；战斗任务的射击次数也没有显示出视角差异。结果限于研究使用的自制游戏与任务，不能推论为所有第三人称游戏都更高效。
decisions.verification: 采用packet内AUTOMATON的研究解析；论文公开时间早于本期，按本期首次发表的技术分析报道处理，不冒充新论文公告或普遍因果结论。
decisions.reason: 具有具体实验方法与结果的信息增量，作为技术分析收录；研究与报道的时间边界已明确区分。

entries.headline: AUTOMATON reports GBA Nintendo Classics has moved to CERO B in Japan
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reported on October 15 that Nintendo’s store listing for GBA Nintendo Classics had changed from CERO A (all ages) to CERO B (ages 12 and up). The report suggested the addition of Metal Slug Advance as a possible reason, but Nintendo had not identified a cause.
entries.verification: Based on the opened AUTOMATON report in the immutable packet. The cause is the outlet’s suggestion, not an official explanation.
entries.timeNote: Timestamp is the report publication time recorded in the original evidence packet, not necessarily when the underlying event occurred.

entries.headline: AUTOMATON examines a Taiwan Tech study separating viewpoint, task speed and immersion
entries.summary: An October 15 AUTOMATON analysis examined an earlier Taiwan Tech shooting-game study. Third-person viewpoint was associated with shorter task-completion times, but viewpoint showed no significant difference in immersion or shots fired in the combat task. These findings concern the study’s custom game and tasks, not every third-person game.
entries.verification: The underlying paper predates this edition; this is coverage of the in-window technical analysis, not a new-paper announcement or a general causal claim.
entries.timeNote: Timestamp is the report publication time recorded in the original evidence packet, not necessarily when the underlying event occurred.
